title: Acerous

inlines.v: AC'EROUS, adjective [Latin acerosus, chaffy, from acus, chaff or a point.] 1. In botany, chaffy; resembling chaff. 2. An acerous or acerose leaf is one which is linear and permanent, in form of a needle, as in pine.
